description: Level-3 MOM OperationsResponse = the manufacturing actuals (B2MML OperationsPerformance). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/operations-response.md, description.

properties.name: operations_response_no
properties.description: Identity of the operations response: its own number from the source system (ISA-95 OperationsResponse.ID; core 4.0.0, F3).

properties.name: production_order_ref
properties.description: The production order (OperationsRequest) these actuals answer (RESPONDS_TO). Until core 4.0.0 this was the key production_order_no.

refStatus.reason: The reference is kept as a value: core 2.0.0 has no edge for it yet.

properties.name: article_revision
properties.description: The revision of the article that was built or used, where the source's article number carries none (a PLM part number with revision A). Empty when the number itself names the revision (at SAP dddd.1).

refStatus.reason: The machine of a response is its SegmentResponse's EquipmentActual — the edge lives there (SMProfile-SegmentResponse ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT); an edge from here would be a shortcut through SegmentResponse (retired 25.09.). Kept as a value (Explorer X1, judged core 6.0.0).

properties.name: quantity_produced
properties.description: Piece count actually produced (actual). Counterpart to qty_planned.

properties.name: cycle_time_actual_sec
properties.description: Actually measured cycle time per piece (s, actual).

properties.name: actual_end_time
properties.description: Actual completion time (actual). Counterpart to planned_end_time.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Actual status of the confirmation. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/operations-response.md, attributes › status › description.

properties.name: completed_at
properties.description: Completion timestamp of the confirmation, if set.

properties.name: updated_at
properties.description: Last change. Server-managed and volatile on every read (sim-v5 returns a fresh value per GET), so promotion:never — kept in the snapshot but excluded from the change-trigger and never published on its own.

properties.name: operations_definition_ref
properties.description: The OperationsDefinition (FOR_OPERATIONS_DEFINITION; ISA-95 OperationsResponse → OperationsDefinition). Optional.

properties.name: operations_definition_version
properties.description: The version of the operations definition this order / response ran with, where the source's definition id carries none (a routing number with its own change state). Empty when the id itself names the version.

properties.name: operations_segment_ref
properties.description: The OperationsSegment (FOR_OPERATIONS_SEGMENT; ISA-95 OperationsResponse → OperationsSegment). Optional.

properties.name: operations_performance_ref
properties.description: The OperationsPerformance this OperationsResponse is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 OperationsPerformance MADE_UP_OF OperationsResponse). Optional.

properties.name: segment_requirement_ref
properties.description: The SegmentRequirement (RESPONDS_TO; ISA-95 OperationsResponse → SegmentRequirement). Optional.

properties.name: operations_type
properties.description: ISA-95 operations type (B2MML OperationsType; Part 3/4: which MOM area the object belongs to; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).

relationships.description: v2.0 — Inverse of SegmentResponse.PART_OF: the actuals per ProcessSegment.

isa95.note: Level-3 MOM OperationsResponse (B2MML) = the actuals. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/operations-response.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML OperationsResponse has no cycle time; completed_at and updated_at are timestamps of the source (the end of the response is actual_end_time). Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent). PLM as-built (owner 29.10.2026): operations_definition_version and article_revision name the state that was built where the source's id carries none; B2MML references a definition by its ID alone (an ID means one state), so there is no field for it — an extension, never part of the key.
